deliverables: Secondary marketplace for listing, pricing, and reselling tickets with on-chain settlement
Smart-contract-level royalty enforcement for configured artist and venue shares
Per-event anti-scalping controls including price ceilings, transfer limits, identity-binding compatibility, and time restrictions
Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's existing user flow with self-custody export
Organizer dashboard and tools for resale parameters, ticket lifecycle data, royalty distributions, and verification
Independent third-party smart-contract security audit with remediation report
Public launch campaign including Big Storm campaign and three trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
request.recipient: Intersect as budget administrator for disbursement through the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC framework, with Anvil Development Agency and Sellout as delivery parties.
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, security audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification, funded entirely by Sellout with over $130,000 invested.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, over 8 months and includes a 3% Intersect administration fee.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and a professional launch campaign.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and currently supports 350+ events annually.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move more than $6 million through Cardano in Year 1, based on $5.88 million historical 2025 activity.
The proposal commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of fees until reimbursement, then a permanent 5% fee afterward.
The revenue-share base definition and cadence are not finalized in the document and are deferred to M1 contracting with the appointed oversight committee.
Milestone-gated disbursement, contingency return, public quarterly reporting, independent audit, and oversight through Intersect and TRSC/PSSC are presented as treasury protections.
Anvil claims a track record of 250+ Cardano projects delivered, 456,000+ assets minted, 50,000,000+ ADA staked through Anvil infrastructure, and 267,000+ on-chain transactions.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month Phase 2 expansion of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, with milestone-gated delivery, Intersect administration, TRSC/PSSC custody, an audit, public reporting, and a proposed treasury revenue-share repayment mechanism; several central adoption and track-record claims are asserted but not evidenced inside the document.
